search_window.basis: Last confirmed completed watch heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger

coverage_notes.search_failure_detail: Initial obsolete CMS Public Notices URL was inaccessible and returned no usable results. Official current CMS Public Notices was subsequently found, opened, and verified successfully; CMS coverage restored.
coverage_notes.coverage: U.S. and territories: hospital/ED, maternity, behavioral health, dialysis, oncology, primary care, rural/emergency services, ambulance and air medical, provider enforcement and restored essential care. 12 targeted last-day searches; indexed reporting can lag local announcements.
coverage_notes.exclusions: Older and previously reported closures including Missouri Fitzgibbon labor/delivery, aggregate maternity-ward trend articles and speculative future shutdowns; Michigan psychiatric facility announced before window and not yet accepting patients; foreign results, unrelated ownership/policy/commentary, routine holiday closures.
coverage_notes.observation: No independently confirmed new qualifying healthcare-access developments in the bounded window. Partial degradation limited to recovered obsolete CMS URL failure.
